text:
Alex: FYI incoming escalation from AcmePay — p95/p99 spiking since yesterday evening, multiple customers affected, reported timeouts and huge billing spikes. Request IDs: rQ2kH7, rQ2kJ2. Logs attached in ticket.
Priya: thanks — linking graphs now. Do we have any recent runtime rollouts around kv allocator / kernel selection?
Alex: Jordan mentioned a small rollout yesterday for kernel-selector v3.4 that included a new kv allocation path (kv_slice_shrink).
Mateo: I see GPU memory pressure on those hosts starting ~2026-03-16T19:20Z. p95 jumped from ~320ms to ~2.9s; p99s to >9s. Memory free metric shows steady decline and then OOM evictions on some GPUs.
Priya: any sign of KV cache growth? that would explain fragmentation + slowdowns.
Mateo: yes — kv_cache_keys per container increased 3.2x on affected pods. KV cache hits stayed similar so it's growth, not better caching. Also slab fragmentation indicator (gpu_mem_frag_pct) rose from ~12% to ~46%.
Alex: Customer also reported repeats of 401 then retries — could be auth retry storm compounding load. AcmePay uses short-lived tokens (60s).
Jordan: they pushed a token refresh change last week. Support ticket shows ~8% of requests getting 401 then immediate client retry. That could multiply active KV states.
Priya: ok hypothesis: increased client retries + kv growth from long seqs -> allocator fragmentation -> occasional OOMs -> long GC/backpressure and high p99. Steps: 1) repro locally with long-seq requests + token-churn; 2) check recent kernel rollout; 3) apply immediate mitigations (server-side).
Mateo: trying a repro now with local cluster: curl -X POST https://api.redwood-ai.dev/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"redwood-large-16k","input":"<long chat>","max_tokens":3000}'
Mateo: repro reproduces p99 ~8.5s within ~200s of steady load when seq_len>4k and token refresh flood. Attaching sample alloc failure log:
```
[2026-03-16T19:35:12Z] GPU0 alloc failed: requested 1.9GiB, free 1.1GiB; slab_alloc_attempts=42; kv_keys=18432; frag_pct=47.8
[2026-03-16T19:35:13Z] OOM triggered, kernel=kv_slice_shrink, fallback=slow-path-compact
[2026-03-16T19:35:14Z] request_id=rQ2kH7 trace=alloc_wait 4.3s
```
Priya: that log aligns with a failing allocator path in the new kernel. We should roll back kernel-selector v3.4 on affected pool ASAP and enable per-request KV trimming.
Alex: Agreed. Action items: Mateo roll back kernel on pool-prod-g and restart 3 affected nodes. Priya add temporary runtime override: kv_trim_threshold=0.5 and max_kv_keys=8192 globally for the pool. Jordan contact AcmePay with ETA and ask them to increase token TTL or implement exponential backoff on 401.
Mateo: rolling back kernel now. Running: ./infra/rollout --pool pool-prod-g --revert kernel-selector:v3.3 --nodes node-41,node-42,node-43
SupportBot: Incident INC-4832 created and linked to ticket TCK-9981 :rotating_light:
Priya: also enabling allocator tuning flags: set /pools/pool-prod-g/runtime/kv_trim_threshold=0.5 and /pools/pool-prod-g/runtime/max_active_kv_keys=8192 — applying in 30s.
Mateo: rollback finished on node-41,node-42; node-43 still draining (restarting). Observed immediate drop in fragmentation metric on node-41 from 48% -> 18% and p99 on that node reduced to ~420ms.
Jordan: I messaged AcmePay with suggested client changes and told them we rolled back kernel and applied mitigations; asked for confirmation if latency improved on their side.
Alex: still need upstream fix — kernel-selector change introduced a bad path for high-churn KV workloads. Priya can you open a follow-up PR to add better unit tests for kv_slice_shrink behavior and a feature-flag gating?
Priya: will do. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/6824 — adds guarded integration test and a runtime config flag runtime.experimental.kv_slice_shrink=false by default.
Mateo: additional monitoring suggestions: alert when kv_cache_keys increase >2x baseline in 5m and async alert for gpu_mem_frag_pct>35% for >2m. Set autoscaler to add 2 nodes when p95>1s for >5m.
Alex: temporary billing note: we saw billing delta due to retries — finance pinged. Jordan, please coordinate to offer a credit if AcmePay saw >2x billing spike.
Jordan: noted, will follow up.
SupportBot: INC-4832 status -> mitigated. Next update scheduled in 30m.
Alex: thanks team. Follow-ups: Priya (root cause + PR), Mateo (postmortem with allocation traces + heatmap), Jordan (customer comms + billing). Closing thread once postmortem link posted. :white_check_mark:
